headline: Memory-card startup and native-port fixes accompany more matching work
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 80.27% to 81.10%, with 4,329 of 5,109 functions reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The memory-card menu fix in #54 lets New Game proceed to Veldin, while native-port work adds functional C that does not earn matching credit.
highlights: #61 adds 35 matches, 149 functional C implementations and joins 22 fragments.
#59 backfills native-port fixes for hits, knockback, crates and sound.
Some functional implementations have not been run in their affected levels.
#56, #57, #58 and #60 opened with further shared-function work and remained unmerged.
